5txstu:181: Before introducing Agent automation, teams should first build the verification system for that domain. The verification system includes: test coverage (unit/integration/end-to-end), compilation and static analysis gates, and formal descriptions of business rules. Introducing Agents without a verification system underneath is essentially stacking uncertainty on top of uncertainty.
